gloss: shot (photo, film, sports); shot (of a drink)

definitions.explanation: A single photograph or camera take, or a single stroke or shot in golf, tennis, basketball and similar sports.
A small measure of spirits or espresso, drunk in one go or added to a drink: テキーラのショット, エスプレッソのショット.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ショット⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{撮|と}れた→撮る：00760_toru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ショット⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まって→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}{勝|が}ち→逆転勝ち：08584_gyakutengachi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His last shot went in, and the team came from behind to win.

examples.japanese: ショット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ナイスショット: nice shot (called out in golf and other sports)
- ツーショット: a photo of two people together
- ショット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hit a shot (golf, tennis)
- ショット⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧: a shot glass

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: one photo — the usual way to count photos
- ⟦シュート→シュート：05926_shuuto⟧: shot at goal in soccer and basketball — the Japanese word for a scoring attempt; ショット is commoner in golf and tennis
- ⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧: a glass, a drink — the general word
